# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Compare the monitoring data with the regulatory standards or emission limits set by local, regional, or national authorities.
3. Record the dates, times, and duration of any excessive emissions.
4. Note the type and concentration of pollutants that exceed the allowable limits.
5. Quantify the excess emissions, if possible, by calculating the mass or volume of pollutants emitted beyond permissible levels.
6. Describe the meteorological conditions (wind speed, wind direction, humidity, temperature) at the time of the emissions, as these can affect air quality and dispersion.
7. Include data from any relevant air quality monitoring stations in the vicinity, if available, to corroborate your findings.
8. Provide photographic or video evidence, if applicable, to visually document the emissions.
9. Mention any operational events, equipment failures, or malfunctions that may have contributed to the excessive emissions.
10. Reference specific sections of any compliance documents, permits, or regulations that were breached.
11.
